visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a boy standing in front of a large, circular, glowing blue aquarium tank filled with various swimming fish. (2) The boy is seen from behind boarding an airplane and later sitting on a red bench at an airport next to a colorful mascot character. (3) Inside an aquarium, the boy uses a small camera to film a sea turtle; close-ups show vibrant coral, jellyfish, and swimming penguins. (4) The boy explores a gift shop featuring shelves of sloth and shark plush toys; he wears a sloth plush attached to his backpack. (5) At a clothing store called NAVY, the boy and his mother examine T-shirts featuring intricate Shiba Inu and cat embroidery designs. (6) The boy interacts with a large bank of Bandai Gashapon machines, turns a dial, and opens a brown capsule to reveal a beetle toy. (7) At an A&W restaurant, the boy is shown drinking root beer and eating a burger and fries; the mother is also shown eating a burger. (8) Transition to outdoor street scenes in Okinawa with palm trees and the entrance to the Ashibinaa Outlet Mall. (9) A detailed sequence shows a customized embroidery process at a GAP store, with close-ups of the sewing machine in action. (10) The boy plays various claw machines at a GiGO arcade filled with neon lights and colorful plush prizes. (11) At Pique Cafe, staff are shown preparing crepes on a hot griddle; the boy and mother sit together enjoying the crepes and drinks. (12) The mother is seen in a fashion boutique, trying on a black skirt and holding a beige handbag. (13) The video concludes with a promotional screen listing various store discounts and coupon information.
